might be true in general. Nevertheless, a general solution seems to be far away.

   This conjecture was previously known in several special cases. A nice nef-partition was

the existence of nice nef-partitions. We prove Conjecture 1.2 in the following stronger form.
Theorem 1.3. Every smooth well formed Fano or Calabi–Yau weighted complete intersection X
admits a nef-partition. If X is Fano, the nef-partition can be chosen so that all weights in the
